findings.message: MCP exposes only a health probe rather than the curated agent operation catalog.
findings.remediation: Generate paginated MCP tools/list and tools/call from the canonical operation registry, including outputSchema, structuredContent, annotations, tasks, and listChanged.

findings.message: The agent operation/OpenAPI registry covers only a subset of API routes and does not classify every remaining route as agent-eligible or internal.
findings.remediation: Classify every route; fully contract agent-eligible routes and explicitly mark internal/operator-only routes.

findings.message: Every operation family docs_ref currently points to a missing document.
findings.remediation: Materialize and validate every operation docs_ref from the canonical descriptor.

findings.message: Per-tool documentation is structurally present but frequently generic and incomplete for deep agent operation.
findings.remediation: Generate specific parameter tables, positive/negative examples, failure recovery, prerequisites, dependency chains, and workflow position for every tool.

findings.message: Machine-readable CLI help is a curated subset rather than an exhaustive generated command schema.
findings.remediation: Generate JSON command schemas, flags, defaults, examples, effects, and migration metadata from Clap authority.

findings.message: Canonical/current audit documents contain stale tool totals.
findings.remediation: Replace hand-maintained totals with generated values and freshness checks.

findings.message: Focusa lacks a dedicated search/describe/graph surface for cold-loading tool schemas and uses family-generic affordances for many tools.
findings.remediation: Add tool search, describe, dependency graph, namespaced bundles, digest/listChanged, and token-budgeted deferred schema loading.

findings.message: Browser interoperability is diagnostics-intake centric; Focusa lacks a machine-readable WebMCP/UIAI capability bridge and browser workflow dependency graph.
findings.remediation: Add UIAI/WebMCP capability discovery, session-isolated browser operation descriptors, evidence contracts, and browser-to-Workpoint workflow graphs.

findings.message: Current tests validate contracts and surfaces but do not score weak-to-strong agents on tool selection, parameter completion, recovery, and cross-tool workflows.
findings.remediation: Add dumb-agent conformance fixtures, golden workflow tasks, invalid-call repair tests, token-cost budgets, and cross-harness behavioral parity evaluation.
